title: Run the game once, unchanged
body:
Make sure your copy builds and passes its quick tests:

```sh
npm ci && node tools/kit.mjs check
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Start the HIGH LOW minigame
check: npm run build && node --test test/mg-bluff.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
body:
Secret cards need a different kit (see docs/design.md), so the first round has nothing hidden:

```sh
node tools/new-mg.mjs bluff bf "HIGH LOW"
```

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-bluff.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: A card everyone sees, and two pads
body:
Show a card to everyone, and put a "higher" pad and a "lower" pad on the table.

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-bluff.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: The wrong pad tips you off
body:
When the next card turns over, the wrong pad tips its balls off the table.

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-bluff.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: See it on your page
body:
Turn on your page once: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions. Then `client/party.html?mg=30` plays HIGH LOW.

```sh
npm run build && node tools/site.mjs
```
